snippet.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 | Vault Edition Trailer [UK]
snippet.description:
Pre Order the Call of Duty: #BlackOps7 Vault Edition and unlock:

🪖 Reznov Challenge Pack
🤝 4 New Operators
🔥 5 Mastercraft Collection Weapons
✚ BlackCell, 1100 COD Points, 20 Tier Skips
🧟‍♂️ Ultra GobbleGum Pack
🎮 Early Access to the Beta starting Oct 2nd
